integrity: Proof depends on executable exhaustive acyclic matching and explicit finite face enumerator supplied with package; no external data, nonstandard dependencies, or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite proof only for categorical product (3,3,4) / mixed Hamming box, not arbitrary triple factors; conjectural sphere count was already stated in 2023; no integral equivariant module computed. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: A 96-three-sphere stage in the mixed ternary–quaternary Hamming box
